correctness.rationale: Each modal root criterion is obtained directly from universal-valuation semantics. McKinsey failure is exactly hypergraph bichromatic two-colorability. Three independently counted collision patterns bound the difference from the canonical degree classification. Outgoing-arc-row independence gives the exact finite multinomial law, and a single-edge-resampling Efron--Stein bound gives variance at most \(c(1+3c+c^2)/n\). The derivative of \(c(1+c)e^{-c}\) has the unique positive root \((1+\sqrt5)/2\). Exhaustive graph-and-valuation checker and an exact weighted four-vertex experiment executed successfully. Unproved joint CLTs and a sharp exception distribution are excluded.
